answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold: an agent earns a trading slot only after trades with 12 distinct counterparties in timber, sable pelts, and velvet cloth. Each trade posts a 50 POA bond, burned if the counterparty proves fake. Forging 1,000 identities needs 12,000 trades and 50,000 POA in bonds, against a reward pool near 2,000 POA, so the attack loses 48,000 POA. Honest agents pay one bond and keep full rewards, since their trades are real.
